definition: A subset A of an ambient topological space is closed in Mathlib's sense IsClosed A. Admitting every stage of a convergent sequence does not imply this policy. This is a mathematical sufficient bridge, not a metaphysical law. Converges is Tendsto atTop (nhds x), StagesAdmitted is range f ⊆ A, and LimitAdmitted is x ∈ A.
